dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, are you going out to investigate?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Well, gathering intelligence is Ryuuji's duty.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Me? Slack off? No way! Hmph, I think you just don't get it!

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Analyzing clues is painstaking work. As the manager at the heart of everything, I just need to patiently wait for the incoming intelligence and analyze them.
